description: x402-perp-funding-radar: Cross-venue funding radar: the same perpetual's funding on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Bybit and Binance, normalised to one hourly basis and annualised, with mark price and open interest side by side, plus the cheapest venue to be long and the richest to be short. Filters: limit (rows, 1-200, default 25), minAnnualSpreadPct (drop thinner annualised spreads), historyDays (0-30, adds a funding-history block), alertAnnualPct (flag extremes above this annual %).
name: x402-perp-funding-radar
